ValidationRule.description: Rule to throw error when user tries to update the field where ‘Scam’ is not recorded in the Issue Type 1, 2 or 3 fields
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false), OR( (RecordType.DeveloperName = "Customer_Complaint"), (RecordType.DeveloperName = "Non_Customer_Complaint") ), AND( NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Scam"), ISPICKVAL(IDR_Issue_Type_2__c, "Scam"), ISPICKVAL(IDR_Issue_Type_3__c, "Scam") ) ), NOT(ISBLANK(Scam_Assist_Case_ID__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Scam Assist Case ID field can only be updated on complaints with a ‘Scams’ Issue Type
